title: Taiwanese American Professionals Orange County 台美菁英協會橙縣分會
content_html: Taiwanese American Professionals Orange County (TAP-OC) is a chapter of the Taiwanese American Citizens League (TACL), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit run entirely by volunteers. Founded in January 2018, TAP-OC serves the Taiwanese American community in Orange County, California through social events, community service, cultural celebrations, and wellness activities. The chapter is inclusive, welcoming people of all cultures and backgrounds.
